name: fighter-edge-functions
description: Backend boundary for EdgeFuel AI (master prompt §13). Holds the OpenRouter key server-side; the Flutter app never calls an AI provider directly.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test lib/validate.test.js lib/billing.test.js lib/openrouter.test.js lib/quota.test.js lib/rules.test.js
scripts.test:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@13.35.1 emulators:exec --only firestore --project fighter-edge-rules-test "npm run build && node --test lib/rules.test.js"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
